definitions.explanation: A traditional Japanese freestanding panel or series of connected panels that can be folded, used for decoration or to divide spaces.

examples.japanese: ⟦{床|とこ}の{間|ま}→床の間：05797_tokonoma⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{金|きん}→金：02666_kin⟧{屏風|びょうぶ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飾|かざ}った→飾る：01185_kazaru⟧。
examples.english: We displayed a gold folding screen in the alcove.

examples.japanese: ⟦{雛人形|ひなにんぎょう}→雛人形：14830_hinaningyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{後|うし}ろ→後ろ：00683_ushiro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{屏風|びょうぶ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{立|た}てる→立てる：01196_tateru⟧。
examples.english: We put a folding screen behind the Hina dolls.

notes:
STRUCTURE: Traditional {屏風|びょうぶ} consists of multiple panels (⟦{曲|きょく}→曲：09881_kyoku⟧) connected by hinges:
- {二曲|にきょく} - 2 panels
- {四曲|よんきょく} - 4 panels
- {六曲|ろっきょく} - 6 panels (most common)
- {八曲|はっきょく} - 8 panels

TYPES:
- ⟦{金屏風|きんびょうぶ}→金屏風：29403_kinbyoubu⟧ - gold folding screen (used at weddings, ceremonies)
- ⟦{銀屏風|ぎんびょうぶ}→銀屏風：29404_ginbyoubu⟧ - silver folding screen
- ⟦{屏風絵|びょうぶえ}→屏風絵：29405_byoubue⟧ - painted folding screen
- ⟦{風炉先屏風|ふろさきびょうぶ}→風炉先屏風：29406_furosakibyoubu⟧ - tea ceremony screen

CULTURAL NOTE:
- Famous historical ⟦{屏風絵|びょうぶえ}→屏風絵：29405_byoubue⟧ include works by artists like {俵屋宗達|たわらやそうたつ} and {尾形光琳|おがたこうりん}
- Used in formal ceremonies, tea rooms, and traditional Japanese interiors
- ⟦{雛|ひな}{祭|まつ}り→ひな祭り：10517_hinamatsuri⟧ displays often include a miniature gold screen

ETYMOLOGY: From Chinese {屏風|びょうぶ} (píngfēng), meaning "wind screen" - originally used to block drafts.
